profile.headline: Software Engineer at J.B. Hunt Transport Services, Inc

positions.title: Instructional Technology Coordinator
positions.description:
•	coded PHP solutions for Moodle Learning Management System
•	developed customized Moodle for language program
•	coded HTML5, CSS3 components for department website and tools
•	utilized Excel, MySQL, and Access for department and student databases
•	provided PC and Mac technical support for large university department
•	designed and delivered one-on-one training, workshops, and tutorial videos for instructional technology tools
•	taught undergraduate and undergraduate non-native English speaking students, international teaching assistants, etc.
•	taught instructional techniques to university professors for a Faculty Enhancement Grant

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
•	created Blackboard English placement test for incoming international students
•	modified initialization files for Apache and PHP 
•	selected hardware and software for PC language-learning lab and assisted in networking and setup
•	maintained Microsoft Access student databases and modified and ran reports for department heads
•	provided Blackboard course setup, administration, maintenance, and support
•	taught English as a Second Language courses at all proficiency levels and skill areas

company.name: Emporia State University, Intensive English Program

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description:
•	taught English as a Second Language courses and American and British history courses
•	developed curricula and Moodle courses for English-education program
•	built website for English-education department and maintained university website
•	taught classes of more than 50 students

positions.title: Technology Support Technician
positions.description:
•	maintained, upgraded, and repaired Mac and PC computers for staff offices and student computer labs
•	maintained and ran reports from Access and Quicken point-of-sale databases
•	maintained staff and student PC network for large university department
•	upgraded building’s network from Token Ring to Ethernet (CAT5)
